description: This file is a shell script that tests the performance and correctness of a lazy initialization hash map implementation, using the 'test-tool lazy-init-name-hash'. It defines various performance and correctness tests for both single-threaded and multi-threaded execution, including hash map consistency verification and calibration runs.

methods.description: Defines success criteria for a test case with a description.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites required for subsequent tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files to verify they are identical.

methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
